notes: Block Pop replaced the 9-activity menu game on 2026-10-13 (kept as classic.html). One deep mechanic: tap a color cannon, blast matching block clusters, clear the tower. v2.4 (2026-10-15): consistent color-note pop sound — each color always sounds its own pentatonic note as a soft root + octave chord, instead of a scale walk that changed with cluster size; no stacked notes on big pops. Content-only repo: no secrets, no personal data beyond the first name.
